name: Apps wake your agent
author: wizard
description: An installed app can wake your agent with a small typed event through the box (wizard-os spec/APP_WAKE.md, wizard.app-wake/1), with no setup by the agent: Messenger's Agent chat wakes your agent within seconds of a note, a Sweep tap or an answer. Only agents you gave that app are woken, never with message text, each wake in its own background thread. Read by the Agent Service (server/app-wake.mjs). Nothing in the shell changes.
